findings.problem: The Electron navigation guard allows any file:// URL to load in the app window. The project plan says main should resolve only application-owned assets, so a renderer navigation to an arbitrary local file is broader than the intended desktop shell boundary.
findings.proposed_fix: Resolve the allowed renderer root once, convert file URLs to paths, and allow only the packaged renderer entry and assets under that root. Prevent all other file:// navigations and update the runtime test to assert that an unrelated local file URL is blocked.

checks_run.summary: Passed; both smoke helper scripts compiled successfully.
Passed; ERD/unit/Electron runtime tests, lint, web build, and Electron runtime test completed successfully. Vite emitted eval and chunk-size warnings but exited 0.

Electron shell behavior.justification: The shell loads the desktop renderer through Electron loadFile, opens the editor route, isolates the renderer, and exposes only a minimal frozen preload API; navigation hardening remains broader than the app-owned-asset contract.

No local web server operation.justification: The packaged-mode path loads dist-desktop/index.html directly and the runtime harness verifies no startup use of HTTP, HTTPS, net, or child-process modules.

Preservation of web build.justification: npm run build passed and the web output remains in dist with root-relative assets, separate from the relative-asset desktop renderer output.

Offline and routing coverage.justification: File-loaded Electron windows use HashRouter and start at /editor; browser URLs still use BrowserRouter. The user-smoke artifact records a successful baseline flow with no blocking errors.

Build-output isolation.justification: dist, dist-desktop, and dist-electron are independently identifiable, and the Electron build emits only main.cjs and preload.cjs.

Test quality.justification: The test suite builds and executes the compiled main module in a harness, but some assertions are source-regex based and the current navigation test permits an arbitrary file URL.

Unified acceptance evidence.justification: npm run verify:ss002 is reproducible and unified for SS-002 because it runs tests, lint, web build, and Electron runtime coverage from one command.
